text:
Predicates:
Hydrocarbons(x) ::: x is a hydrocarbon.
OrganicCompounds(x) ::: x is an organic compound.
Alkanes(x) ::: x is an alkane.
ChemicalCompounds(x) ::: x is a chemical compound.
ContainsCarbon(x) ::: x contains carbon.
ContainsOnlyOneElement(x) ::: x contains only one element.
Mixture(x) ::: x is the mixture.
Premises:
∀x (Hydrocarbons(x) → OrganicCompounds(x)) ::: All hydrocarbons are organic compounds.
∀x (Alkanes(x) → Hydrocarbons(x)) ::: All alkanes are hydrocarbons.
∀x (OrganicCompounds(x) → ChemicalCompounds(x)) ::: All organic compounds are chemical compounds.
∀x (OrganicCompounds(x) → ContainsCarbon(x)) ::: All organic compounds contain carbon.
∀x (ChemicalCompounds(x) → ¬ContainsOnlyOneElement(x)) ::: No chemical compounds contain only one element.
Mixture(m) ∧ (ChemicalCompounds(m) ⊕ ContainsOnlyOneElement(m)) ::: The mixture either both is a chemical compound and contains only one element, or neither.
Conclusion:
ContainsCarbon(m) ::: The mixture contains carbon.
